details.resources: No equipment or cloud experiment instances

document.coverage_limits: Numerical agreement within supplied cells only; no correctness, compliance, causal, operational or population validation.
document.dates_or_epochs: Use the explicit identities and epochs in the input; no present-day substitution.
document.dependence: Dependencies may exist; no independent replications or population inference are asserted.
document.exclusions: Unmatched observations are excluded and recorded; duplicates, unit mismatches and changed inputs fail the run.
document.hypotheses: Numerical agreement is checked separately from correctness, causality and generalization.
document.missing_data: Absent expected observations remain missing. Invalid and ambiguous values remain distinct from recorded zero.
document.prior_exposure: Synthetic development fixtures inspected during implementation; no held-out or scientific validation.
questions: Do every supplied matched numerical observation and separately sourced published value agree under the declared absolute tolerance?
document.replication_unit: The explicitly identified observation; no independence is inferred between observations.

resource_limits.cost_basis: Local or API hosting costs are unallocated; missing charges are not zero. No experiment instances or model calls are requested.

document.sample_size_rationale: Census of the supplied published comparison cells, with unexpected observations preserved as exclusions.

sensitivity.rationale: This campaign checks one fixed declared tolerance; amended tolerances require separate protocols.

document.statistics: Descriptive exact comparisons only; no inferential intervals.
document.stopping_rule: Stop on an input identity, schema, configuration, units or budget violation; preserve the failed attempt.
